package.description: A library for the game assets you collect, with their licenses and sources on record.

en-US.description: A library for the game assets you collect, with their licenses and sources on record.
en-US.longDescription:
Tessera keeps every asset pack whole, with its license and source on record, so you can find a
piece in seconds and send it into a Unity, Godot or Unreal project with the credits written for
you.
en-US.name: Tessera
